messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated GPU paging detected on cluster gpu-req-prod-7, SLO impact. Opened incident.
maya: seeing spikes in device-paging and two runtime OOMs on instance g7-12. dashboards: https://dash.re/redwood/gpu-paging?t=3468129999
sam: confirmed increased page faults / swap IOPS starting 02:17:34 UTC. latency p95 for textgen route jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s.
maya: can someone take oncall? I need a reboot for a customer meeting.
alex: taking oncall handoff. I am @alex — jumping in. What are top hypotheses?
devon: logs show repeated KV cache growth for long-chat sessions + a burst of 512-token batched requests. suspect KV cache fragmentation + batch-size spike. snippet: 
```
2026-03-16T02:17:38Z gpu-req-prod-7 kernel: page_faults=13452, swap_in=4023, kv_cache_entries=1.9M
2026-03-16T02:18:01Z runtime: OOMalloc: failed to allocate 256MB, evicted 0 pages
```
lia: customer impact: some requests returned 503 between 02:18:00-02:21:30 UTC in us-west2, ~1.4k requests affected, mostly chat endpoints.
alex: OK. Immediate mitigations: 1) reduce batch size on hot route to 64, 2) trigger KV cache soft-evict on gd-** suffix, 3) divert traffic to standby region us-east1 if latency stays high. I'll apply 1 & 2 now.
ops-bot: action run: route-change apply batch-size=textgen=64 by @alex — queued.
ops-bot: action run: kvcache-evict --tag=gd-candidate --type=soft by @alex — completed.
alex: batch-size change rolled out to 50% at 02:19:12, 100% at 02:20:05. Seeing p95 drop to 300-400ms. paging rate down ~70%.
sam: sharing logs + full timeline here: https://logs.re/redwood/incident/3468129999 — includes kernel traces, runtime heap dumps, batch histograms.
maya: thanks. any sign of bad kernels or allocator regression?
devon: allocator looks stable; pattern is sustained KV cache size growth combined with sudden large batched infer requests that push memory past soft limits -> paging.
lia: customer comms: posted to status page: "Reduced throughput and intermittent errors affecting chat in us-west2. Mitigations deployed; monitoring."
alex: current status — mitigated. p95 steady at ~350ms, no new OOMs in last 10m. Leaving incident open for RCA. Tasks: collect heap dumps from g7-12, correlate request IDs for heavy batches, evaluate soft-evict threshold.
maya: noted. assign follow-ups to eng-runtime and eng-ml: batch-smoothing + kvcache-guardrails.
ops-bot: pager cleared at 02:30:50.
alex: final quick hypothesis list in-thread:
- H1: KV cache growth from long-context sessions + not enough eviction pressure.
- H2: Sudden large batch-size spike (autoscaler behavior / client burst) pushed working set over physical GPU memory -> paging.
- H3: Kernel-level allocation hot-path amplified fragmentation under heavy eviction.
Will capture artifacts and prepare timeline for postmortem.
lia: I'll track customer impact metrics and include request samples.
devon: saving heap dumps to s3://redwood-incident-archives/3468129999/ and flagging interesting traces.
alex: thanks all — handing back to maya for PM notes and postmortem writeup.
maya: taking. marking incident as "mitigated (partial)" — moving to RCA tracking doc.
